title: Models Overview
content:
# Models Overview

A list of all our available models, helping you explore their capabilities, performance, trade-offs, and more.

# Featured Models

# Mistral Medium 3.5

Our frontier-class multimodal model optimized for agentic and coding use cases.

# Mistral Small 4

Hybrid model unifying instruct, reasoning, and coding in a single efficient model.

# Voxtral Mini Transcribe Realtime

An efficient audio input model, pre-trained and optimized for live transcription purposes.

# Voxtral TTS

State-of-the-art TTS with zero-shot voice cloning and multilingual support.

# OCR 4

Our latest OCR service with paragraph-level bounding boxes and structural block labels.

# Devstral 2

Our frontier code agents model for solving software engineering tasks.

# Frontier Models

# Generalist

Versatile, high-performing models suitable for a broad range of tasks.

# Mistral Medium 3.5

Our frontier-class multimodal model optimized for agentic and coding use cases.

# Mistral Small 4

Hybrid model unifying instruct, reasoning, and coding in a single efficient model.

# Mistral Large 3

A state-of-the-art, open-weight, general-purpose multimodal model.

# Ministral 3 14B

A powerful model offering best-in-class text and vision capabilities.

# Ministral 3 8B

A powerful and efficient model offering best-in-class text and vision capabilities.

# Ministral 3 3B

A tiny and efficient model offering best-in-class text and vision capabilities.

# Specialist

Models optimized for specific domains or a given purpose.

# Voxtral TTS

State-of-the-art TTS with zero-shot voice cloning and multilingual support.

# Leanstral 1.5

Updated code agent for Lean 4 formal proof engineering and automated theorem proving.

# OCR 4

Our latest OCR service with paragraph-level bounding boxes and structural block labels.

# OCR 3

Our OCR service powering our Document AI stack. OCR 4 is available as the newer model. OCR 3 remains available for existing integrations and production workloads.

# Voxtral Mini Transcribe 2

An efficient audio input model, pre-trained and optimized for transcription purposes.

# Voxtral Mini Transcribe Realtime

An efficient audio input model, pre-trained and optimized for live transcription purposes.

# Codestral

Our cutting-edge language model for code completion released end of July 2025.

# Codestral Embed

Our state-of-the-art semantic for extracting representation of code extracts

# Voxtral Small

Our first model with audio input capabilities for instruct use cases.

# Mistral Moderation 2

Our latest moderation model with 128k context window and jailbreaking detection.

# Other Models

# Other Models

Other supported models available.

# Mistral Embed

Our state-of-the-art semantic for extracting representation of code extracts

# Legacy/Deprecated

# Legacy Models

Older models that have been deprecated or retired.
